chunks: What is the matter with you that you do not help each other?

key_terms.لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ: do not help each other (mutual assistance)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'What is the matter with you that you do not help each other?'
ai.summary: In Surah As-Saff, this verse serves as a divine rebuke to the believers for their internal discord and failure to support one another in the path of Allah, highlighting the necessity of *ta'awun* (mutual assistance). Shia scholars emphasize this as a foundational principle for communal unity (*ittihad*) and readiness for struggle (*jihad*), linking it to the concept of *Amr bil Ma'ruf* (enjoining good) within the community. It underscores that true faith manifests not just in individual piety but in collective solidarity and active support among the faithful.
